LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.label: spell staff
LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.description: A prototype staff that casts instead of shooting. Its attack casts the spellbook bookmark chosen on its gizmo; the staff remembers the slot, not a copy, so editing that page changes what it casts. Without a saved spell it cannot attack.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Basic.label: spellbook
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Basic.description: A forest spellbook worn at the hip. In forest-blooded hands it holds the caster's spells and deepens their mana; to anyone else it is only paper.
